answer: Attention-Backed Identity Slots. Each identity must hold a jade slot earned by continuously reading a live verification feed; slots rotate and laggards lose them. An attacker pays the opportunity cost of keeping every duplicate attentive in real time, since idle replicas drop like fruit from an orchard. A crystal ledger records slot tenure, so freshly spun sybils can't borrow history. Cost scales with sustained human-like attention per identity, not one-time fees.
